name: Besput'e
source:
After death there is no memory, no feelings.
Found himself at unroaded lands, the vagrant was forced to choose directions. And with that to make decisions about who he should be now.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1031110/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
死亡之後沒有記憶，也沒有感情。
流浪者發現自己身處無路之地，被迫選擇方向，也因此必須決定自己今後要成為怎樣的人。

[來源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1031110/]Steam[/url]]
